items.title: Temple Courtyard Incense Offering
items.desc: Reverent evening devotees offering jasmine blossoms and earthen oil lamps at the sacred Bodhi precinct.

items.title: Sigiriya Fortress of the Cloud Realm
items.desc: The 5th-century rock citadel rising 200 metres sheer above emerald jungle canopy and water gardens.

items.title: Polonnaruwa Vatadage Circular Shrine
items.desc: Masterwork medieval rock carving housing four seated granite Buddha statues facing the cardinal points.

items.alt: Kandy Sri Dalada Maligawa Golden Canopy
items.title: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
items.desc: The golden-canopied sanctum sanctorum of Sri Dalada Maligawa on the shores of misty Kandy Lake.

items.title: Ruwanwelisaya Stupa at Sunset
items.desc: The towering white stupa built by King Dutugemunu in 140 BC, surrounded by the elephant stone frieze.

items.title: Dambulla Rock Cave Murals
items.desc: Five painted rock cave sanctuaries adorned with 2,100 square metres of murals and 157 Buddha statues.

items.title: Demodara Nine Arches Viaduct
items.desc: The colonial stone railway bridge standing gracefully amid deep highland forest and misty tea plantations.

items.title: Verdant Valleys of Little England
items.desc: Rolling green contours of high-grown Ceylon tea estates framed by cascading waterfalls and eucalyptus forests.

items.alt: Ella Rock Trek and Mountain Ridge
items.title: Ella Gap & Little Adam's Peak
items.desc: Panoramic morning views across the southern plains from the razorback ridge of Little Adam's Peak.

items.alt: Sri Lankan Leopard on Granite Rock
items.title: The Phantom of Yala
items.desc: The endemic Sri Lankan leopard (Panthera pardus kotiya) resting on sun-warmed coastal granite boulders.

items.alt: Asian Elephant Herd at Minneriya Gathering
items.title: The Great Asian Elephant Gathering
items.desc: Hundreds of wild elephants congregating on the lush green tank-bed of Minneriya in dry season harmony.

items.title: Sinharaja Virgin Rainforest
items.desc: Sri Lanka's last viable primary tropical rainforest, harboring 95% of the island's endemic bird species.

items.alt: Mirissa Bay Sunset and Ocean Catamaran
items.title: Mirissa Gold-Hour Horizon
items.desc: Sunset sailing over Indian Ocean trenches where deep-water Blue Whales and Spinner Dolphins gather.

items.alt: Galle Fort Lighthouse and Dutch Ramparts
items.title: Galle Fort Ocean Ramparts
items.desc: Living 17th-century maritime fortress featuring coral-stone bastions, cobblestone lanes, and colonial spice trade mansions.

items.alt: Passikudah and Nilaveli Calm Turquoise Bay
items.title: Passikudah Crystal Reef Lagoon
items.desc: Pristine white-sand shallow reef waters where you can walk hundreds of metres out into the warm, transparent sea.

items.title: Tangalle Secluded Coves
items.desc: Wild coconut palms bowing over turquoise breaking swells, secluded boutique retreats, and turtle nesting shores.

items.title: Bentota Golden Peninsula
items.desc: Where the tranquil freshwater river meets the Indian Ocean swell, designed by architect Geoffrey Bawa.

items.title: Serene Contemplation in the Hills
items.desc: Peaceful morning mist walks through heritage bungalows, private blessing ceremonies, and organic garden dining.
